title: Computing Absorbing-Frequency Centrality: Complexity, Estimators, and Scalable Algorithms for Stochastic Networks
summary: In a stochastic network, where edges fail and weights may vary across realizations, the node of highest betweenness is itself random. Absorbing-frequency centrality (AFC) scores each node by how often it is reported as the node of highest betweenness: the reported betweenness maximizer traces an absorbing Markov chain, and AFC is the normalized expected pre-absorption occupancy.
